items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: So I went with Lawrence, with Buddy Manaday over in Manderville... where we played out in Covenant over there. For that Saturday night dance.

ctx.x: Well, I didn't know him. I definitely heard of him.

Buddy Manaday. I called him Buddy Manaday from Manderville. He stayed in Manderville. He played banjo. Yeah. Cause I went over there. Right. I'm telling you, he stayed over Manderville. Well, I'll tell you what happened. When Sadie got able to go back on the boat, where Buddy Manaday and Lawrence Tocco came to see the house of Sadie living on Allen. That's when I was here. And, uh, they wanted Sadie or somebody to do a piano player, understand? So that's when Lawrence and Manaday came over there, and Sadie and I…
Well, anyway, after you left Buddy Petit and those guys, you went back to Birmingham, you said, with the Nighthaw. Yeah. How long did you stay there?
